title: CryptoSlax - Custom Linux Distribution
summary: Customized, ultra-lightweight (~100 MB) stateless Linux distribution engineered for PXE network boot, RAM execution, and 24/7 autonomous GPU clusters.
highlights: 100% diskless architecture booting via PXE/TFTP directly into volatile RAM with zero local storage.
Modular SquashFS and OverlayFS layer stacking for kernel, AMD/NVIDIA drivers, and mining binaries.
Complete immunity to hard power cuts and filesystem corruption; direct architectural prototype for Project SOYUT.
